jobs.title: Team Lead Product Manager, Mobile Apps (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
A career driven by you. Join AutoScout24 Group and experience life in the fast lane. We’re not just leading the market; we’re creating it. We’re constantly innovating, evolving and transforming things for our customers. We’re driven, ambitious and determined to do our best work, together. For a career that doesn’t stand still, where you can put your ideas in the driving seat and change the way the world moves, join our international community. 

As Team Lead Product Manager - Mobile Apps, you will own the vision and strategy for AutoScout24’s mobile app experience across iOS and Android. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Commercial teams to ensure we build intentionally for mobile, not simply adapt web experiences to the app. You will bring strong mobile product expertise, using data, experimentation, and native app capabilities to improve engagement, retention, and the overall customer experience.

What you’ll do:

Mobile Product Strategy

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AutoScout24’s mobile app experience
  • Drive mobile-first thinking across product teams and identify opportunities unique to app users.
  • Set clear goals, success metrics, and KPIs for engagement, retention, and customer experience.

Cross-Product Leadership

  • Partner with Product Managers across different customer journeys to translate customer problems into mobile-native solutions.
  • Influence teams without direct ownership, bringing strong mobile expertise and challenging web-first assumptions.
  • Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Commercial stakeholders around mobile priorities.

Product Discovery & Delivery

  • Use customer insights, data, experimentation, and market understanding to identify and validate opportunities.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
  • Drive initiatives from discovery through delivery, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Customer & Data Focus

  • Deeply understand mobile customer behaviour, needs, and pain points.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative insights to guide decisions.
  • Continuously monitor performance and improve key product metrics.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with strong experience building consumer mobile apps at scale.
  • Proven experience shaping mobile product strategy and delivering meaningful improvements in engagement, retention, or customer experience.
  • Experience influencing across multiple product teams and working closely with Engineering, Design, and Data.

Skills

  • Strong strategic thinking with a clear point of view on how mobile experiences should differ from web.
  • Deep understanding of mobile user behaviour, native app capabilities, engagement, and app growth.
  • Strong analytical skills, including product analytics, experimentation, and KPI ownership.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong business judgement and the ability to balance customer and commercial outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or other consumer digital products.
  • Experience with personalization, monetization, subscriptions, or growth products.
  • Familiarity with outcome-driven product management and modern discovery practices.

A culture of growth  

With over 50 nationalities represented, we’re proud to welcome people of all backgrounds to our growing community, and we’re always finding new ways to help people feel welcomed and included. Here, you’ll have the tools, training and support you need to work in a way that suits you, learn new skills and reach your potential.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Userlane Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally. Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications. 

 Your mission Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as: 
 Defining metrics that hold up : Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete. 

 Delivering outcome-linked metrics : Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on 

 Building for time-poor executives : Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?" 

 Connecting fragmented data sources : Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems, 

 Transforming insights into action : Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once 

 AI adoption governance : Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI. 

 

 

 Your profile 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation 

 You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't.

jobs.title: CDD - ARCHITECT PROJECT MANAGER (F/H)
jobs.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS 

 

 Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. 

 Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. 

 

 Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). 

 

 Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). 

 

 

 ROLE 

 
 This temporary position is to be filled as soon as possible.

 Support the Architecture/Store Planning team in the development, management, monitoring and coordination of architectural projects for the opening/renovation of our boutiques respecting the brief, budget and management of schedules.

 MISSIONS 

 

 Design : 

 
 
 Prepare and collect the information necessary for the implementation of projects, debrief and coordination through various departments

 Prepare CAD drawings, 3D models and project presentations for design development

 Material research and sample-boards preparation

 
 

 Planning control/coordination : 

 
 Manage project coordination with internal and external parties

 Assist on Bid preparation and support on the result analysis and monitoring of project cost

 Review shop drawings and technical submissions from contractors and suppliers

 Monitor the progress of project & construction milestones and support in keeping the targets

 
 

 General activities : 

 
 Make and issue periodic reports on ongoing projects and related meetings

 Update the projects database and material library

 Research and certification/follow-up for suppliers and consultants

 

 

 PROFILE 

 
 
 Education: Degree in Architecture

 3–6 years experience in Architecture (ideally in Luxury field) within a brand and/or architecture studio

 Strong understanding of construction detailing and project delivery processes

 Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously at different levels of advancement

 Skills & Expertise: Organised, team player, rigorous and detail oriented, flexible, agile

 Languages: English and French

 Good computer skills including: AutoCAD, SketchUp (V-Ray is a plus), Photoshop, Adobe Suite and Excel

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Data, Pricing and Roaming

 Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben Vom ersten Tag an mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du verantwortest die Antwortqualität von Piqit, unserem KI-gestützten Shopping-Assistant, der aus über 100 Millionen Angeboten das passende Produkt findet – und zwar von der ersten Beobachtung bis zur ausgerollten Änderung.
 Qualität heißt hier nicht Treffermenge, sondern Antwort: Du prüfst, ob Piqit verstanden hat, worum es geht, ob die vorgeschlagenen Produkte wirklich die richtigen sind und ob die Einordnung dazu trägt.
 Ursachenforschung ist deine Kerndisziplin: Wenn eine Antwort nicht überzeugt, unterscheidest du sicher, ob die passenden Produkte gar nicht gefunden wurden, ob in den Produktdaten ein Attribut fehlt oder falsch belegt ist oder ob das Modell aus guten Daten etwas Falsches gemacht hat.
 Du kennst die Eigenheiten von Sprachmodellen: stark bei Absicht, Nuance und Sprache, unzuverlässig bei exakten Zahlen, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität – und dabei immer überzeugend klingend. Genau dieses Gespür bringst du in jede Entscheidung ein.
 Hands-on statt Konzeptpapier: Prompt-Sets, Hints und Regeln schreibst und rollst du selbst aus, Attribute und Facetten schärfst du selbst nach, Testsets baust du selbst – und wiederkehrende Handgriffe automatisierst du weg, gern KI-gestützt.
 Du misst, was wirkt: Einzelfälle sind kein Beleg, dieselbe Anfrage kann zweimal unterschiedlich beantwortet werden. Du prüfst gegen eine feste Sammlung von Testanfragen und bewertest die Veränderung über alle hinweg. Der Weg von der Beobachtung zur Änderung ist kurz, vieles geht am selben Tag live. 
 Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Data und Engineering: Für Themen, die tiefer in der Pipeline liegen, arbeitest du eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen. Was du nicht selbst umsetzen kannst, übersetzt du in fundierte Anforderungen an Engineering und Data – mit Beispielen, Zahlen und einer klaren Priorisierung.
 Neue Shops, neue Daten: Du begleitest die Partneranbindung, prüfst, was die Antwortqualität wirklich trägt, und sagst klar, wenn ein Sortiment noch nicht live gehen sollte.
 Kategorie-Management ist dein Schlüssel: Kategorien, Attribute und Facetten entscheiden mit darüber, was der Assistent über ein Produkt überhaupt weiß – und weil semantische Ähnlichkeit allein nicht reicht, sobald es um Maße, Kompatibilität oder harte Grenzen geht, legst du hier selbst mit Hand an.
 

 Deine Stärken Du kannst relevante Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle vorweisen, in der du ein Produkt wirklich vorangetrieben und nicht nur begleitet hast

 Deutsch beherrschst du verhandlungssicher, gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

 Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

 The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
 GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

 What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
 You are technical enough to argue with engineers. 
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
 You can write. 
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
 You write specs worth acting on. 
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
 You know what looks good. 
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
 You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. 
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
 You want to be coached hard. 
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
 You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. 
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
 You want the scope to grow. 
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

 What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. 
 Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
 Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
 Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
 Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
 Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients
 
 What you'll be scoping over your first year: 
 Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
 Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
 AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
 Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
 You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.

 Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
 Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
 Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
 Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background
 Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
 Notion fluency
 
 Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.

 How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.
 Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
 Interview with the PM, including a brief intro

jobs.title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
jobs.description:
About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. 

 Hybrid by design:  
 We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
 Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
 Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
 Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
 Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
 Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
 Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
 Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
 Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
 Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
 Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
 Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
 Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
 Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D)
jobs.description:
The ILF Solar Photovoltaic & hybrid systems team works across a vast range of large-scale renewables projects and programs, both grid connected and off-grid across private and public sectors globally. We offer you to join a dynamic environment and to work on unique and exciting projects (including floating PV, complex hybrid systems, combination with Hydrogen, rural electrification, etc.).
 
 Join our Team in Munich or Fontainebleau / Paris to contribute to the transition toward a decarbonized and sustainable energy future!
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D) 
 

 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 You will operate as a Senior Project Manager - Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) for strategic projects worldwide. Your clients will include International Finance Institutions (AFD, KfW, World Bank, EBRD, EIB, etc.), national power utilities, major private clients (industrial, project developers, etc.).

 During development phase of the projects, you will lead Feasibility studies of complex power plant systems including system sizing / optimization, CAPEX and OPEX estimation, conceptual / detail design and layout, grid studies (PSS/E, Power Factory), energy master plan studies (PLEXOS, PyPSA), etc. Your activities could also include to lead TDD, LTA as well as Technical Transaction Advisor projects.

 During implementation phase , you will lead the tender design, evaluation of EPC/IPP offers, reviewing and validating the executive design before construction (design vetting). Your will also be overseeing the supervision of the construction, commissioning and O&M phase.

 As an interface between suppliers, IPP / EPC contractors and clients you keep up to date with and pass on market trends, technology development, new products, standards and simulation models.

 Your engineering skills will contribute to the standardization of work processes with the goal of enhancing efficiency and quality.

 You will also support the development of our international activities by preparing proposals and supporting business development initiatives.

 
 YOUR QUALIFICATIONS: 
 Graduated in the field of energy, electrical engineering or similar with a focus on Renewable Energies / Photovoltaics / Energy Storage Systems (ESS).

 At least 10 years of experience in large scale photovoltaic & battery systems with robust project management and engineering skills. Expertise in Wind and Green Hydrogen projects would be a plus.

 Experience with Energy software such as PVSyst, HOMER PRO, and/or Power system Software (Power Factory, PSS/E) is required.

 Understanding of technical aspects of PPA and EPC contracts regarding performance and penalties is required.

 Excellent writing skills

 Very good written and spoken skills in English and in French.

 
 
 
 91% of our employees consider ILF Germany & France a “Great Place to Work”. 
 
 Friendly company culture and diversity in everyday practice 
 Numerous local and cross-regional events strengthen team spirit, and the majority of our employees address each other on a first-name basis. We are particularly proud of the international diversity of our teams, which bring together more than 30 nationalities.

 Modern working environment

jobs.description:
About Intch
 Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part-time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months.  What you’ll do
 Own the B2C product end to end, including its P&L.

 Drive growth through hypothesis-driven experiments and measurable improvements in acquisition, activation, and retention.

 Own the product metrics and use data to guide decisions and prioritisation.

 Conduct CustDev interviews and build a deep understanding of user behaviour across a global, multilingual audience.

 Partner with the B2B product teams to make the B2C product the connective layer across Intch’s product ecosystem.

 Report directly to the founder and take over the product vertical they currently lead.
 

 What you need to succeed
 5+ years of experience in product management.

 A strong B2C growth track record, including experiments, acquisition, and measurable results.

 Proven experience scaling a product that already has strong product–market fit.

 Strong product sense and a hypothesis-driven approach to problem-solving.

 Comfort working with data and translating insights into action.

 Experience working in a startup or another fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

 High autonomy, accountability, and comfort working without micromanagement.

 Fluent Russian.

 Full ownership of a profitable, fast-growing product and its P&L, reporting directly to the founder.

 A deliberately compact team (under 40 people) where everyone has a large area of ownership and streamlined collaboration.

 Flat, cross-pollinating structure: anyone in the company can bring a validated idea to your product. You can do the same across other verticals.

 Paid vacation and sick leave.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. 

 Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen.
 Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen.
 Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung.
 Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick.
 Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen.
 Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden.
 Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab.
 Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
 Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern.
 Beraten & Wissen vermitteln Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien.
 Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse.
 Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien.
 

 Was du mitbringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager: Agentic Discovery
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery 
 About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.
 Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.
 This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.
 You'll start by owning the business tooling and dashboards for agentic discovery — the experiences that let business teams see what our agents are doing, why, and to what effect, so they can execute faster and steer with confidence. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Agentic Discovery chapter: the on-site agentic experiences, the offsite/agentic surfaces, the integrations that connect them, and the agentic tooling underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.
 Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.
 If you're excited about defining a brand-new category, being held to real usage and business outcomes, and giving businesses control over the AI experiences shaping their storefronts, this role is for you.
 What You'll Do 
 Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in usage and business outcomes — conversion, revenue, engagement — across Constructor's agentic experiences.

 Give businesses transparency and control. Build the dashboards and tooling that let business teams see what agentic experiences are doing, understand why, and steer them — closing the gap to the control they have in traditional search.

 Scale experimentation. Turn one-off agentic experiments into a repeatable, scalable way to launch, measure, and improve new agentic interfaces — cutting time-to-launch.

 Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for Agentic Discovery — where we're heading and why — tie it to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

 Lead the business-tooling and dashboard experience first. Own its strategy and roadmap, and make agentic behavior and impact visible and actionable for business users.
  

 Orchestrate across surfaces. Unite on-site agentic experiences, offsite/agentic surfaces, and integrations behind one definition of agentic discovery success, so improvements compound instead of colliding.
  

 Turn AI capability into shipped experiences. Partner with ML and engineering to take agentic and LLM-powered experiences from idea to production, balancing quality, latency, cost, and reliability.
  

 Make success measurable. Define and instrument the metrics — go-live velocity, usage, engagement, business outcomes — that tell us whether agentic discovery is working.
  

 Keep it trustworthy. Treat explainability, control, and guardrails as first-class requirements so customers trust and adopt agentic experiences.
  

 Grow the mandate. Expand from business tooling into chapter-wide leadership across the full agentic portfolio and the integrations beneath it.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - DevEx
jobs.description:
Our mission

 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

 How you'll help us achieve it 

 Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

 AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

 The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

 
 Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.

 Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.

 Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.

 Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.

 Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.

 Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.

 Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

 
 In this role, you'll... 

 
 Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.

 Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. 

 Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.

 Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.

 Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.

 Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.

 Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

 
 Key Details 

 
 This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso

 Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.

 Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.

 Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.

 Major benefits:

 
 Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).

 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.

 Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 

 $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

 

 
 Requirements 

 
 Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.

 Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.

 Speak fluent English

jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
jobs.description:
Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”
 
Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. 

 Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
 TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
 DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
 BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
 COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
 USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.
 

 What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
 Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
 Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
 Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
 Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.

 Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
 Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
 Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. 

 Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. 

 At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

 As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

 As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
 You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
 You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
 You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
 You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
 You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. 
 You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. 
 

 Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
 Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
 Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. 
 Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. 
 Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. 
 Business fluency in both  English and German  is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.

In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis.

 We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us.

 Tasks

 What You'll Do

 
 Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks.

 Analyze business requirements and break them down into roadmaps, timelines, epics, tickets and tasks — and defend the cut list.

 Document, analyze and improve the whole user journey on both sides of the marketplace: candidates and employers have competing interests, and those trade-offs are yours to make rather than escalate.

 Create actionable concepts for new products and features, estimate effort and ROI, own the process from ideation to delivery.

 Decide where AI belongs and where it does not. Run experiments with the expected outcome written down first, then verify and iterate.

 Define KPIs, track them, improve them, revise them. Within 90 days we expect one metric you moved, with a baseline, a number, and a read you can defend to the leadership team.

 Collaborate with stakeholders, developers and the data team, and use data-driven storytelling to align them.

 
 Requirements

 Must have

 
 5+ years in Product Ownership/Management, shipping with cross-functional agile teams.

 Experience building or scaling marketplaces, job boards, or recruitment platforms — two-sided funnels behave differently and we would rather not teach that from scratch.

 Data-driven by default: you write your own analytics questions, read an experiment result, and say "this did not work" out loud. Analytics, A/B testing, experimentation.

 Strong ability to define product vision, roadmaps and priorities against business goals, customer needs and technical constraints — including clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for complicated workflows and funnels.

 Excellent written German and English. Our users, employers and support team are German-speaking; our codebase and documentation are English.

 
 Nice to have

 
 Search and SEO, including the AI-answer variants (AIEO, AEO, GEO) — a growing share of our traffic.

 Matching or recommendation systems: you know why offline metrics and business metrics disagree.

 Healthcare hiring workflows and empathy for the field — shift work, qualification recognition, and why a nurse does not read email at 14:00.

 SQL. Not required, but the people who enjoy this role usually have it.

 
 Benefits

 
 Decision authority. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths are not a slogan here: you will not need a committee to ship, and you will not get to blame one either.

 Direct access to the data — our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics. You query it yourself instead of filing a ticket and waiting.

 Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front.

 Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership.

 An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere.

 Central Berlin office in a beautiful old building, plus flexible remote

Job description Who we are  
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

 The Role 
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

 Your responsibilities Therapy ownership:  You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. 
 Behavior & retention:  You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. 
 Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end. 
 App Store excellence: You treat ratings, store presence, and ASO as core product levers, and actively optimize the funnel from impression to activation.
 

 YOUR TOOLKIT Mobile expertise:  Hands-on product management experience with consumer mobile apps. 
 Platform fluency:  You understand the technical realities of iOS and Android and know how to work with them – not around them. 
 Data & AI fluency: You use AI to move fast, know when it's hallucinating, and back every decision with analytics and experiments, because you own the outcome.
  Languages:  Fluent in German and English. 
 High agency:  You naturally push topics forward, bring people along, and don't wait to be asked. 
 Taste:  You know what a great, beautiful, yet functional product needs to look like in 2026. 
 Optional – health or behavior background:  Experience building patient-centric or behavior-change products, or genuine passion for it.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Alternative Payment Methods
jobs.description:
Company Description 
 We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 
 
 We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

 Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

 If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

 With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 
 
 Product Manager: Alternative Payment Processing 
 Checkout.com is seeking a Product Manager and leader to join our team of product managers working to add and improve our Alternative Payment Method (APM) portfolio, with a focus on bank-based payment rails. This role will help drive our company OKR of expanding and enhancing the payment methods we offer merchants around the world, helping these businesses grow their global footprint. The successful candidate will provide cross-functional leadership across product, engineering, and business teams, to ensure our APM portfolio is embedded throughout Checkout.com ’s ecosystem, enabling a seamless experience for our merchants. They will work across the business and engage with merchants to align on the selection of APMs, drive the recommended approach to offer or improve them, design the API experience and collaborate with more than twenty stakeholder teams to deliver APMs end-to-end. Daily tasks include understanding stakeholders’ pain points, driving prioritization for product development, and developing new capabilities for our customers.
 
 About you: 
 3-5 years of product management experience.

 Experience working in payment methods, especially direct debit and account-to-account payment methods

 Data-driven: Skilled at leveraging data and business insights to determine strategic priorities and drive the product roadmap and execution.

 Customer-first: Think from the customer's perspective and can balance future opportunities with immediate needs.

 End-to-end mindset: Think in a structured and diligent manner, understanding all key components necessary to drive the ongoing success of a product.

 Leadership: Excellent at collaborating with stakeholders in product, engineering, commercial, and business teams proactively, demonstrating high EQ and influencing skills.

 Effective communicator: Able to inspire others with a shared vision and simplify complex concepts for a wide range of audiences.

 
 Key responsibilities: 
 Set the strategy for your portfolio of APMs, including understanding the target market, customers and aims for each APM, to determine the best approach for delivering the APMs, and how to balance adding new APMs vs working on enhancements for the existing portfolio, using qualitative and quantitative research and data to make decisions.

 Become an expert in your payment methods, working closely with the payment partners to understand trends and drivers for success, which you will leverage to support our commercial team and drive value for our merchants.

 Work with engineering and product counterparts to design the API and integration for each APM, to deliver an optimal developer experience which balances a consistent API experience across Checkout.com ’s products with the nuances of each different APM.

 Build strong partnerships with business, product, and technology stakeholders and work with them for their buy-in and collaboration to generate momentum for your products

 Work with other product and engineering leaders to ensure alignment with their roadmaps and delivery

 Gain a deep understanding of Checkout.com ’s customers and business. 

 Foster a team culture that upholds Checkout.com ’s operating principles.

 If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
 
 Product Marketing Manager, AI Governance (EMEA)
 
 Location: EMEA
 
 About the Role
 Kong is building the connectivity layer for the AI era — securing, governing, and monetizing every LLM, MCP, agent, and API request in production.
 As the Product Marketing Manager for our AI portfolio, you'll be the commercial engine behind the fastest-moving part of our business. Working alongside a team of deeply technical product marketers who own positioning for AI traffic management, agent identity, and AI observability, you'll plan the launches, campaigns, and content that drive pipeline.
 This is a high-leverage execution role. You'll own launches, content, and campaign execution across the entire AI portfolio, serving as the single interface between AI R&D and the demand generation, field marketing, and sales teams that bring our story to market.
 What You'll Do
 Own launch execution across the AI portfolio — Manage the launch calendar, tiering framework, and cross-functional launch process for all AI product releases, coordinating inputs from technical PMM specialists into cohesive go-to-market moments.

 Drive campaign strategy and content — Partner with demand generation and field marketing to build campaign briefs, messaging frameworks, and content assets (web copy, ebooks, webinars, videos) that translate technical differentiation into buyer-relevant narratives.

 Serve as the commercial interface layer — Act as the single point of contact between the AI product marketing team and downstream marketing and sales functions, ensuring consistent messaging across every AI offering.

 Support field and partner enablement — Collaborate with the revenue enablement team to deliver launch-aligned sales assets, talk tracks, and competitive positioning for the AI portfolio.

 Coordinate with event marketing — Drive AI portfolio presence at flagship events, including product announcements, session content, and booth messaging.

 Measure and iterate — Track launch and campaign performance, gather field feedback, and continuously refine messaging and asset strategy based on what moves pipeline.

 Who You Are
 2+ years of experience in product marketing, product management, or solutions engineering — ideally at an AI/ML platform company.

 A genuine, hands-on interest in AI infrastructure. You follow developments in LLM deployment, agentic frameworks, the Model Context Protocol, and AI governance, and can speak credibly to AI platform engineers without bluffing.

 A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into crisp narratives that land with both technical practitioners and C-suite buyers.

 A track record of developing product launches, sales enablement materials, and competitive intelligence programs that move pipeline and accelerate deals.

 Highly collaborative — you thrive working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams.

 Comfortable owning a stage: keynote presentations, analyst briefings, customer roundtables, and demo-heavy sessions energize you rather than intimidate you.

 Experience in open-source software, SaaS platforms, and enterprise go-to-market motions is strongly preferred.

 Familiarity with the AI connectivity landscape — including awareness of competing and complementary vendors across API gateways, AI observability, vector databases, iPaaS, and agentic orchestration frameworks — is a strong plus.

 
 About Kong: 
 Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com .

You’ll be a critical member of the Engage group, responsible for building long-term product value and loyalty across our Kraken products—on both mobile and web.

jobs.title: Product Director – Field Service / Facilities Management
jobs.description:
The Joblogic Story

Established in 1998, Joblogic is the UK’s #1 Field Service Management (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the UK, Pakistan, and Vietnam. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from ~£500K ARR to ~£35M+ ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.

Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from Vista Equity Partners — a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over £100 million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our AI-first roadmap, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.

With Vista’s backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to £100M ARR across international markets.

Joblogic provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over 100,000 users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.

We're hiring a Product Director to lead the strategy, vision, and execution of Joblogic's product portfolio across Field Service and Facilities Management. This is a senior leadership role for someone with broad product expertise, deep domain understanding, strong people leadership and mentoring skills, and a proven ability to design, build, and scale AI-powered products in B2B SaaS.

You'll own the product vision and roadmap across our entire FSM and CAFM platform, lead, grow, and mentor a high-performing product team, and partner with the executive team to translate market opportunity into commercial outcomes. You'll also be the driving force behind our AI-first product agenda — defining where AI delivers genuine value, embedding intelligence into core workflows, and ensuring we ship responsibly and at pace.

Above all, this is a people leadership role. You'll be the coach, mentor, and standard-setter for the product team — building careers, raising the craft bar, and creating the kind of environment where ambitious product people do their best work. You'll be equal parts strategist, people leader, and product craftsperson.

What You'll Own

You'll lead product across the Joblogic platform, including:

Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies.
